notes.latency: Summed model latency of every call an agent made for a diagram, in seconds; stages run 4-way concurrent across diagrams, so wall-clock per diagram is lower.
notes.3b: The Diagram Animator Critic's latency is its call count x 31.9 s, the measured mean per call.
notes.mapping: 1b is the Raster Integrator and 1c the Diagram Transmuter Critic, as the data shows.

baselines.note: Closed-source prices are the providers' official standard API prices per million prompt / completion tokens, checked on 2026-09-22 against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing. OpenRouter lists GPT-5.6 Sol at $2 / $10, which is OpenAI's batch/flex rate, not its standard rate. Anthropic notes that Opus 4.7 and later tokenize the same text into about 30% more tokens, so the Opus estimate is likely low.
